decision.observation: Car at 9 mph, all dots dark, red X cleared, centred on tarmac. The lane sweeps left-then-right ahead: a leftward kink near the car, then a rightward bend past the four cream/red OIL barrels and two OIL banners up-screen. A blue puddle sits just ahead of the nose.
decision.hypothesis: The immediate kink is to the left, so pure throttle risks drifting to the outside; a short left-steered hold should track the near kink while speed is still low.
decision.memory: Clean aligned tarmac at 9 mph — this is the fastest sustained stretch yet; steering in small 0.4s bites rather than long holds.
